app.name: Polkadot Developers
app.description: Official documentation and tutorials for building smart contracts and chain integrations on Polkadot Hub.

reviewMethod: Agent review of official product documentation and production network configuration; maintainer-authorized publication through tested main
notes: This is an ecosystem developer resource, not a deployed DApp. Network association denotes explicitly documented Polkadot Hub coverage, using assethub-polkadot, not generic ecosystem membership or a claim to deploy on every parachain. Listed networks are the verified subset in this directory, not an exhaustive product support list. No funded transaction or security audit was performed.
